**Highest-impact improvements**
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/Library.tsx#L48`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/Library.tsx#L71`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/Library.tsx#L80`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/Library.tsx#L87`: this is the strongest jank candidate. The scroll position is written into Recoil on every scroll event, then restored again whenever that state changes. That means scrolling can trigger rerenders and delayed DOM writes continuously. The biggest win would be to stop syncing scroll position on every event, keep it in a ref while scrolling, and persist it only on unmount, route change, or a throttled/debounced interval.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/Library.tsx#L144`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/Library.tsx#L109`: the filtered and sorted library list is recomputed during render, and the sort mutates the filtered array in place. Wrap the derived list in a memoized selector or useMemo, avoid in-place sorting, and precompute unread counts once per series instead of recalculating them repeatedly during filter and sort.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/LibraryGrid.tsx#L67`:  on the multi-select array is linear per card. For large libraries this becomes noticeably expensive. Store selected ids in a Set or use a map keyed by series id.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/LibraryGrid.tsx#L66`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/general/ExtensionImage.tsx#L55`: cover rendering is image-heavy and every card can trigger image resolution work. Add lazy loading, cache resolved URLs by series id/url, and avoid remounting images when unrelated UI state changes.

**Rendering and DOM scale**
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/LibraryList.tsx#L21`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/LibraryGrid.tsx#L66`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/series/chapter-table/ChapterTable.tsx#L633`: these views render the full item set directly. If the library is large, virtualization is the most effective structural fix. A windowed list or grid would reduce DOM size, layout work, and repaint cost dramatically.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/series/chapter-table/ChapterTable.tsx#L118`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/series/chapter-table/ChapterTable.tsx#L633`: the chapter table defines columns and renders rows inside the component body, so the table configuration is rebuilt every render. Memoize the column definitions and extract row/cell pieces into smaller components so unrelated state changes do not invalidate the whole table.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/series/chapter-table/ChapterTable.tsx#L482`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/series/chapter-table/ChapterTable.tsx#L589`:  sorts the chapter list and is called more than once during render. - `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/SeriesDetails.tsx#L80`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/SeriesDetails.tsx#L131`: the details page uses nested scrolling depending on the setting. Nested scroll containers can feel worse than a single scroll region because the browser has to manage more overflow contexts. If smoothness matters more than layout flexibility, consider one scroll container and sticky header sections instead of multiple overflow areas.

- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/Library.tsx#L255`: the library shell already uses overscroll control and an internal ScrollArea. +const scrollViewportSelector = '[data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]';
+
+const getUnreadCount = (
+  series: Series,
+  seriesChapterMetadata: Record<string, { unreadChapters: number }>,
+): number => {
+  if (!series.id) return 0;
+  return seriesChapterMetadata[series.id]?.unreadChapters ?? 0;
+};
+
+const filterSeriesList = (
+  seriesList: Series[],
+  filter: string,
+  libraryFilterStatus: string | null,
+  libraryFilterProgress: ProgressFilter,
+  libraryFilterCategory: string | null,
+  libraryDisplayMode: LibraryDisplayMode,
+  seriesChapterMetadata: Record<string, { unreadChapters: number }>,
+): Series[] => {
+  const normalizedFilter = filter.toLowerCase();
+
+  return seriesList.filter((series: Series) => {
+    if (!series || series.preview) return false;
+
+    if (!series.title.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedFilter)) return false;
+    if (libraryFilterStatus !== null && series.status !== libraryFilterStatus) return false;
+
+    const unreadCount = getUnreadCount(series, seriesChapterMetadata);
+    if (libraryFilterProgress === ProgressFilter.Unread && unreadCount === 0) return false;
+    if (libraryFilterProgress === ProgressFilter.Finished && unreadCount > 0) return false;
+
+    if (libraryFilterCategory && (!series.categories || !series.categories.includes(libraryFilterCategory))) {
+      return false;
+    }
+
+    if (libraryDisplayMode === LibraryDisplayMode.FilterByCategory) {
+      if (series.categories && series.categories.length > 0) return false;
+    }
+
+    return true;
+  });
+};
+
+const sortSeriesList = (
+  seriesList: Series[],
+  librarySort: LibrarySort,
+  seriesChapterMetadata: Record<string, { unreadChapters: number; latestChapterAddedTimestamp: number }>,
+): Series[] => {
+  const sortedSeries = [...seriesList];
+
+  switch (librarySort) {
+    case LibrarySort.UnreadAsc:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => getUnreadCount(a, seriesChapterMetadata) - getUnreadCount(b, seriesChapterMetadata));
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.UnreadDesc:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => getUnreadCount(b, seriesChapterMetadata) - getUnreadCount(a, seriesChapterMetadata));
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.TitleAsc:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.TitleDesc:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => b.title.localeCompare(a.title));
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.DateLastRead:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => {
+        const dateCompare = new Date(b.lastReadDate || 0).getTime() - new Date(a.lastReadDate || 0).getTime();
+        return dateCompare === 0 ? a.title.localeCompare(b.title) : dateCompare;
+      });
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.ChapterUpdate:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => {
+        const aLatestDate = a.id ? seriesChapterMetadata[a.id]?.latestChapterAddedTimestamp || 0 : 0;
+        const bLatestDate = b.id ? seriesChapterMetadata[b.id]?.latestChapterAddedTimestamp || 0 : 0;
+
+        const dateCompare = bLatestDate - aLatestDate;
+        return dateCompare === 0 ? a.title.localeCompare(b.title) : dateCompare;
+      });
+      break;
+    default:
+      break;
+  }
+
+  return sortedSeries;
+};

+const getUnreadCount = (

+): number => {
+  if (!series.id) return 0;
+
+  return seriesChapterMetadata[series.id]?.unreadChapters ?? 0;
+};
+
+const filterSeriesList = (
+  seriesList: Series[],
+  filter: string,
+  libraryFilterStatus: SeriesStatus | null,
+  libraryFilterProgress: ProgressFilter,
+  libraryFilterCategory: string | null,
+  libraryDisplayMode: LibraryDisplayMode,
+  seriesChapterMetadata: Record<string, SeriesChapterMetadataSummary>,
+): Series[] => {
+  const normalizedFilter = filter.toLowerCase();
+
+  return seriesList.filter((series: Series) => {
+    if (!series || series.preview) return false;
+
+    if (!series.title.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedFilter)) return false;
+    if (libraryFilterStatus !== null && series.status !== libraryFilterStatus) return false;
+
+    const unreadCount = getUnreadCount(series, seriesChapterMetadata);
+    if (libraryFilterProgress === ProgressFilter.Unread && unreadCount === 0) return false;
+    if (libraryFilterProgress === ProgressFilter.Finished && unreadCount > 0) return false;
+
+    if (libraryFilterCategory) {
+      if (!series.categories || !series.categories.includes(libraryFilterCategory)) return false;
+    }
+
+    if (libraryDisplayMode === LibraryDisplayMode.FilterByCategory) {
+      if (series.categories && series.categories.length > 0) return false;
+    }
+
+    return true;
+  });

+
+const sortSeriesList = (
+  seriesList: Series[],

+  seriesChapterMetadata: Record<string, SeriesChapterMetadataSummary>,
+): Series[] => {
+  const sortedSeries = [...seriesList];
+
+  switch (librarySort) {
+    case LibrarySort.UnreadAsc:
+      sortedSeries.sort(
+        (a: Series, b: Series) => getUnreadCount(a, seriesChapterMetadata) - getUnreadCount(b, seriesChapterMetadata),
+      );
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.UnreadDesc:
+      sortedSeries.sort(
+        (a: Series, b: Series) => getUnreadCount(b, seriesChapterMetadata) - getUnreadCount(a, seriesChapterMetadata),
+      );
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.TitleAsc:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.TitleDesc:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => b.title.localeCompare(a.title));
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.DateLastRead:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => {
+        const dateCompare =

@@
 import LibraryControlBarMultiSelect from './LibraryControlBarMultiSelect';
 import { ScrollArea, ScrollBar } from '@houdoku/ui/components/ScrollArea';
 import { RemoveSeriesDialog } from './RemoveSeriesDialog';
+
+type SeriesChapterMetadataSummary = {
+  unreadChapters: number;
+  latestChapterAddedTimestamp: number;
+};
+
+const getUnreadCount = (
+  series: Series,
+  seriesChapterMetadata: Record<string, SeriesChapterMetadataSummary>,
+): number => {
+  if (!series.id) return 0;
+
+  return seriesChapterMetadata[series.id]?.unreadChapters ?? 0;
+};
+
+const filterSeriesList = (
+  seriesList: Series[],
+  filter: string,
+  libraryFilterStatus: SeriesStatus | null,
+  libraryFilterProgress: ProgressFilter,
+  libraryFilterCategory: string | null,
+  libraryDisplayMode: LibraryDisplayMode,
+  seriesChapterMetadata: Record<string, SeriesChapterMetadataSummary>,
+): Series[] => {
+  const normalizedFilter = filter.toLowerCase();
+
+  return seriesList.filter((series: Series) => {
+    if (!series || series.preview) return false;
+
+    if (!series.title.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedFilter)) return false;
+    if (libraryFilterStatus !== null && series.status !== libraryFilterStatus) return false;
+
+    const unreadCount = getUnreadCount(series, seriesChapterMetadata);
+    if (libraryFilterProgress === ProgressFilter.Unread && unreadCount === 0) return false;
+    if (libraryFilterProgress === ProgressFilter.Finished && unreadCount > 0) return false;
+
+    if (libraryFilterCategory) {
+      if (!series.categories || !series.categories.includes(libraryFilterCategory)) return false;
+    }
+
+    if (libraryDisplayMode === LibraryDisplayMode.FilterByCategory) {
+      if (series.categories && series.categories.length > 0) return false;
+    }
+
+    return true;
+  });
+};
+
+const sortSeriesList = (
+  seriesList: Series[],
+  librarySort: LibrarySort,
+  seriesChapterMetadata: Record<string, SeriesChapterMetadataSummary>,
+): Series[] => {
+  const sortedSeries = [...seriesList];
+
+  switch (librarySort) {
+    case LibrarySort.UnreadAsc:
+      sortedSeries.sort(
+        (a: Series, b: Series) =>
+          getUnreadCount(a, seriesChapterMetadata) - getUnreadCount(b, seriesChapterMetadata),
+      );
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.UnreadDesc:
+      sortedSeries.sort(
+        (a: Series, b: Series) =>
+          getUnreadCount(b, seriesChapterMetadata) - getUnreadCount(a, seriesChapterMetadata),
+      );
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.TitleAsc:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.TitleDesc:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => b.title.localeCompare(a.title));
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.DateLastRead:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => {
+        const dateCompare =
+          new Date(b.lastReadDate || 0).getTime() - new Date(a.lastReadDate || 0).getTime();
+        return dateCompare === 0 ? a.title.localeCompare(b.title) : dateCompare;
+      });
+      break;
+    case LibrarySort.ChapterUpdate:
+      sortedSeries.sort((a: Series, b: Series) => {
+        const aLatestDate = a.id ? seriesChapterMetadata[a.id]?.latestChapterAddedTimestamp || 0 : 0;
+        const bLatestDate = b.id ? seriesChapterMetadata[b.id]?.latestChapterAddedTimestamp || 0 : 0;
+
+        const dateCompare = bLatestDate - aLatestDate;
+        return dateCompare === 0 ? a.title.localeCompare(b.title) : dateCompare;
+      });
+      break;
+    default:
+      break;
+  }
+
+  return sortedSeries;
+};
*** End Patch

I’ve applied the targeted rollback for lazy loading and tightened image loading safety; next I’ll run error/lint/build/release checks to ensure this fix is stable.One terminal session still can’t resolve `pnpm`, so I’m using the explicit `corepack.cmd` path for consistent verification and checking the build result log.I fixed the two regressions you reported and re-validated the app pipeline.

What I changed
1. Removed forced lazy loading for library covers so cards load up front again.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/library/LibraryGrid.tsx`

2. Reworked image loading to be safer and smoother while keeping caching.
- Kept URL caching.
- Added a stable async loader path used by both mount and retry.
- Removed a retry-path scope bug that could reference an out-of-scope loader.
- Restored default image loading behavior to eager (instead of lazy).
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/general/ExtensionImage.tsx`

Why this addresses your two issues
- Issue 1 (cards only loading when scrolled): was directly caused by forcing lazy image loading on each series card.
- Issue 2 (sporadic wheel movement / pause pattern): on-demand image fetch+decode during wheel scrolling can cause repeated hitches; restoring eager loading removes that just-in-time stall pattern.

Validation results
- Lint passed:
  - corepack.cmd pnpm --filter @houdoku/desktop lint
- Build passed:
  - pnpm --filter @houdoku/desktop build
- Windows release packaging still produces artifacts:
  - `apps/desktop/release`
  - `apps/desktop/release/win-unpacked`

Platform compatibility
- Changes are renderer-level React/TypeScript only (no OS-specific API behavior added), so they are compatible for PC, macOS, and Linux/Ubuntu.
- From this Windows environment I validated Windows build/release directly; macOS/Linux packaging cannot be executed here, but nothing in these code changes is platform-specific.

If you want, I can next add a balanced preload strategy (first N covers eager, rest lazy) behind a setting, so startup stays smooth on very large libraries without reintroducing scroll hitching.

 export const preloadSeriesImages = async (
   seriesList: SeriesImageSource[],
   resolveUrl: (series: SeriesImageSource) => string | undefined,
 ): Promise<void> => {
   await Promise.allSettled(seriesList.map((series) => preloadSeriesImage(series, resolveUrl(series))));
 };
+
+export const preloadSeriesImagesInBatches = async (
+  seriesList: SeriesImageSource[],
+  resolveUrl: (series: SeriesImageSource) => string | undefined,
+  batchSize: number = 12,
+): Promise<void> => {
+  for (let index = 0; index < seriesList.length; index += batchSize) {
+    const batch = seriesList.slice(index, index + batchSize);
+    await Promise.allSettled(batch.map((series) => preloadSeriesImage(series, resolveUrl(series))));
+
+    if (index + batchSize < seriesList.length) {
+      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
+        window.setTimeout(resolve, 0);
+      });
+    }
+  }
+};
*** End Patch
